questions: When the board is fully in view, are there exactly three pens on it (no missing pen and no empty gap)?
Do all three pens point the same direction, with none flipped or reversed relative to the other two?
Are all three pens the same color as each other, with none differing in color?
Is every pen complete and capped, with none showing a bare/exposed writing tip or looking clearly shorter than the others?
Does the board move smoothly and continuously from left to right, without stopping, freezing, pausing, reversing, or jamming at any point?

question_answers.evidence: When the board is fully centered (approx 00:08-00:10), exactly three pens are clearly visible in a row.
All three pens are oriented vertically with the darker capped end pointing downwards and the barrel pointing upwards.
All three pens appear identical in color, featuring translucent barrels and black caps.
All pens appear to have their caps on and are of equal length; no bare tips or shortness is visible.
The board moves steadily from left to right across the frame without stopping or reversing.

parsed.reason: The video shows three identical pens, correctly oriented and capped, moving smoothly on the board from left to right. No anomalies were detected.

description: Three identical pens moving left to right on the board, smooth continuous motion.
